parameters.jsCode: 'use strict';const source=$('Code | Validate Immutable Folder User Identity | UserFolderProvision').first().json;let r={};try{r=JSON.parse(String($json.stdout||$json.data||'{}').trim())}catch{throw new Error('folder_filesystem_receipt_invalid')};if(r.verified!==true||r.folderRoot!==source.folderRoot||r.mode!=='700'||Number(r.directories)!==4)throw new Error('folder_filesystem_verification_failed');return [{json:{...source,filesystemReceipt:r}}];

parameters.jsCode: 'use strict';const expected=$('Code | Verify Filesystem Receipt | UserFolderProvision').first().json;const raw=$json.body??$json;const r=Array.isArray(raw)?raw[0]:raw;const t=v=>String(v??'').normalize('NFKC').trim();if(r?.success!==true||r?.verified!==true)throw new Error('folder_postgres_receipt_invalid');for(const k of ['principalKey','storageUsername','userId','tenantId','qdrantCollection','soulId','folderRoot'])if(t(r[k])!==t(expected[k]))throw new Error(`folder_postgres_receipt_mismatch:${k}`);if(t(r.telegramActorId)!==t(expected.telegramActorId)||r.filesystemVerified!==true||t(r.filesystemMode)!=='700')throw new Error('folder_postgres_filesystem_receipt_mismatch');return [{json:{...expected,...r,folderFilesystemReceipt:expected.filesystemReceipt,folderProvisionStatus:'done',folderProvisionVersion:'chelsea_folder_provision_v3',completedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];
